channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Men's HIL: Hyderabad Toofans decimate Bengal Tigers
item.description: In the day’s other fixture, table-toppers Vedanta Kalinga Lancers maintained their perfect run with a 6-1 victory over SG Pipers, extending their winning streak to five matches.

item.title: WPL 2026: Smriti Mandhana, Lauren Bell power RCB to fourth straight win
item.description: Smriti Mandhana fell four short of what would have been the first century in WPL history.

item.title: PWL 2026: UP Dominators and Haryana Thunders register dominating wins
item.description: UP outclasses the Tiigers of Mumbai Capitals; meanwhile, Haryana claimed its second win against Delhi Dangal Warriors.

item.title: Bharti Fulmali, Shreyanka Patil return as BCCI announces squad for India tour to Australia
item.description: India will travel to Australia for a multi-format series in February-March, having 3 T20Is, 3ODIs and one test match.

item.title: Exploring the heart of Indian Football: The Travellers Guide to Indian Football Series
item.description: From Kolkata’s maidans to Sikkim’s mountain pitches, Indian football survives not on systems alone but on people, memory, and culture.

item.title: Tadu Abate and Yeshi Chekole dominate as Ethiopians sweep titles at Mumbai Marathon 2026
item.description: Ethiopian runners claimed both elite titles at the 21st Tata Mumbai Marathon, while Indian athletes Sanjivani Jadhav and Kartik Karkera led the domestic field.

item.title: Blue Tigresses fall 0–2 to FC Metalist 1925 in first Türkiye friendly
item.description: Second-half goals from Ukrainian internationals handed India a defeat in their opening preparatory match ahead of the AFC Women’s Asian Cup 2026.

item.title: Kalinga Lancers extend unbeaten run in Men’s Hero HIL
item.description: Shrachi Bengal Tigers kept their playoff hopes alive with a dramatic 3–2 comeback win against SG Pipers, while table-toppers Vedanta Kalinga Lancers maintained their unbeaten streak with a shootout victory over Accord Tamil Nadu Dragons.

item.title: PWL 2026: ​Manisha Bhanwala leads Maharashtra Kesari to its first win of the season
item.description: The Maharashtra team took a dominant 6-3 win over the Tiigers of Mumbai Dangals.

item.title: Tata Steel Chess Wijk Aan Zee: Praggnanandhaa faces a second consecutive defeat
item.description: Pragg lost to Uzbek GM Nodirbek Abdusattorov in round 2, following his first-round defeat to Arjun Erigaisi.
